method: Opaque-pixel empirical RGB CDF matching using monotonic 256-entry per-channel lookup tables, round-to-nearest 8-bit. Apply RGB only where alpha > 0. No redraw, resampling, blur, alpha edits or spatial operations.
limitations: Matching channel distributions does not guarantee identical joint RGB palettes or visual acceptance; local joins can still need paint-over. Already painted pixels are not automatically updated.
